title: Scalar completion of lattice fibres and normalized mixed coherence
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $X$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and finite intermediate fields $E\subset L$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Write $A_E=\mathcal O_E$, choose a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $B_{E,X}=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A_E/\varpi_E^n)_X$ and $E_X=B_{E,X}[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. These are the continuous completed coefficient sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the derived-complete constructible integral categories with compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], their raw rationalizations $D^b_c(X,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], their bounded localized standard t-structures [prop-weil-localized-tstructure], and the pair category $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with the finite scalar functors $T_{L/E}$ and associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

Write $\mathscr A_E(Z)$ for the finite-stage standard heart, $J_Z$ for its continuous rational realization [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], and $\omega_{\bar z,E}$ for the normalized exact finite-dimensional geometric fibre [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-exactness]. Its lattice prescription on an affine etale chart of a lisse stratum is $M_{\bar z}=\varprojlim_n(N_n)_{\bar z}$ and $\omega_{\bar z,E}(F)=M_{\bar z}[1/\varpi_E]$, with a fractional lattice arrow $u/\varpi_E^a$ acting by $\varpi_E^{-a}\varprojlim_n u_n$.

Let $E\subset L$ be finite coefficient fields, $A=\mathcal O_E$, $D=\mathcal O_L$, $t=\varpi_E$, $v=\varpi_L$, and $e$ the ramification index. On an affine etale lattice chart of $F\in\mathscr A_E(X)$ let $N_\bullet$ be its normalized finite-free tower, $M=\varprojlim_n(N_n)_{\bar x}$, and $n(m)=\lceil m/e\rceil$. The scalar lattice of the actual $T_{L/E}F$ has reduction tower $N_{n(m)}\otimes_{A/t^{n(m)}}D/v^m$ [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves, lem-per-lisse-completed-system-comparison]. Its finite stalk is canonically $M\otimes_A D/v^m$, and the reduction-cone completion map $M\otimes_A D\to\varprojlim_m(M\otimes_A D/v^m)$ is an isomorphism. The model is pinned to the realization comparison $J_L(T_{L/E}QK)\cong L_X\otimes_{E_X}J_E(QK)$ induced by the actual completed integral scalar extension, localization and balanced tensors; on the chart its integral lattice is $N\otimes_{B_{E,X}}B_{L,X}$, with $N$ the reconstructed lisse lattice. Inverting the uniformizers in the inverse completion map gives a natural isomorphism $\beta_{L/E,F}:\omega_{\bar x,L}(T_{L/E}F)\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{\bar x,E}(F)\otimes_E L$, both sides being canonically $M\otimes_A L$. This normalization uses finite free modules and their completion, not commutation of arbitrary tensor products with inverse limits.

For every scheme map $g:Y\to X$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, use $\alpha$ of [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-pullback]. The mixed pullback/scalar square commutes. At finite quotient level it is the square whose stalk scalar arrow sends $a\otimes s_{\bar x}$ to $(a\otimes s)_{\bar x}$ and whose pullback arrow sends a pulled germ to its original germ [lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar]. This holds also for non-flat coefficient quotient maps. In a tower $E\subset L\subset P$, both scalar-composition arrows send $(s\otimes a)\otimes b$ to $s\otimes ab$, and identity extension sends $s\otimes1$ to $s$. These are exactly the specified scalar associators, not freely chosen isomorphisms. All these equations commute with quotient projections, their inverse limits and rationalization. The comparisons are natural for every fractional lattice map and independent of lattice, chart, adapted stratification and fractional representative: conjugating by a fractional integral comparison on a common refinement gives the comparison in the other model. In particular the combined $\alpha,\beta$ satisfy the quotient, identity, scheme-composition, coefficient-composition and mixed coherence equations.

proof.text: Obtain the objectwise scalar fibre components together with their normalized fibre family and pullback.

Use naturality to form each scalar natural isomorphism by NatIso.ofComponents. Its components are definitionally the given objectwise isomorphisms, so the universal germ and local normalization formulas are retained verbatim.

Use the tensor and mixed equations for these components. Choose the explicitly constructed full-heart restrictions of the actual raw scalar unit, associator and mixed map as the existential heart comparisons. Their underlying maps agree by reflexivity, unfolding the irreducible raw scalar associator only for its component identification. Assemble all six fields of NormalizedScalar.
